statement.text:
Let G = B(m, n) be the free Burnside group of rank m and of odd exponent
n ≫ 1. Are the following statements true?
    a) Every 2-generated subgroup of G is isomorphic to the Burnside n-product of
two cyclic groups.
                                                                     2     n
    b) Every automorphism φ of G such that φn = 1 and bφ · bφ · · · bφ = 1 for all
b ∈ G is an inner automorphism (here m > 1).
    Editors’ comment: for large prime n this follows from (E. A. Cherepanov, Int. J.
Algebra Comput., 16 (2006), 839–847), for prime n ⩾ 1009 from (V. S. Atabekyan,
Izv. Math., 75, no. 2 (2011), 223–237); this is also true for odd n ⩾ 1003 if in addition
the order of φ is a prime power (V. S. Atabekyan, Math. Notes, 95, no. 5 (2014),
586–589).
    c) The group G is Hopfian if m < ∞.
    d) All retracts of G are free.                                           S. V. Ivanov
